```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(ggplot2)
library(xgboost)
library(dplyr)
```

```{r}
# 1. Load the Data
# Change this filename to whatever file you downloaded (e.g., "combined_postseason_data.csv")
df <- read_csv("mlb_2025_season_andPost.csv", show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
  filter(!is.na(pfx_x), !is.na(pfx_z), !is.na(spin_axis))

df_24 <- read_csv("mlb_2024_season.csv", show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
  filter(!is.na(pfx_x), !is.na(pfx_z), !is.na(spin_axis))

# =======================================================
#   1. DATA SETUP (Standard Physics Definitions)
# =======================================================


ssw_data <- df %>%
  mutate(
    # Y-AXIS DATA: What the Camera sees (Spin)
    Observed_Axis = spin_axis, 
    
    # X-AXIS DATA: What the Movement implies
    Raw_Angle = (180 + atan2(-pfx_x, pfx_z) * 180 / pi) %% 360,
    
    # Hemisphere Check
    Inferred_Axis = ifelse(abs(Raw_Angle - Observed_Axis) > 90, 
                           (Raw_Angle + 180) %% 360, 
                           Raw_Angle),
    
    # Deviation Calculation
    SSW_Deviation = Inferred_Axis - Observed_Axis
  )


ssw_data_24 <- df_24 %>%
  mutate(
    # Y-AXIS DATA: What the Camera sees (Spin)
    Observed_Axis = spin_axis, 
    
    # X-AXIS DATA: What the Movement implies
    Raw_Angle = (180 + atan2(-pfx_x, pfx_z) * 180 / pi) %% 360,
    
    # Hemisphere Check
    Inferred_Axis = ifelse(abs(Raw_Angle - Observed_Axis) > 90, 
                           (Raw_Angle + 180) %% 360, 
                           Raw_Angle),
    
    # Deviation Calculation
    SSW_Deviation = Inferred_Axis - Observed_Axis
  )

# =======================================================
#   2. THE PLOT: SWAPPED AXES
# =======================================================

ggplot(ssw_data %>% filter(pitch_name %in% c("Sinker", "Changeup", "4-Seam Fastball")), 
       # --- THE SWAP IS HERE ---
       aes(x = Inferred_Axis, y = Observed_Axis, color = pitch_name)) + 
  
  # The "Line of Truth"
  geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, color = "black", linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 1) +
  
  geom_point(alpha = 0.5, size = 3) + 
  
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(0, 360), breaks = seq(0, 360, 90)) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 360), breaks = seq(0, 360, 90)) +
  coord_fixed() +
  theme_minimal() +
  
  labs(
    title = "Seam-Shifted Wake: Observed vs. Inferred",
    # IMPORTANT: With Inferred on X, 'More Movement' means X > Y, so dots drop BELOW the line.
    subtitle = "Dots BELOW the line = Movement > Spin (Sinker Effect)",
    
    x = "Inferred Axis (Movement / PFX)",    # X-AXIS
    y = "Observed Axis (Camera / Spin)",     # Y-AXIS
    color = "Pitch Type"
  )
```

```{r}
# Assuming you already ran the previous 'ssw_data' code...

# Create the "Insight" Column
analyzed_data <- ssw_data %>%
  mutate(
    Insight = case_when(
      # Case 1: The Elite Sinker (Good SSW)
      pitch_name == "Sinker" & SSW_Deviation > 15 ~ "ELITE: Seams are creating extra sink/run.",
      pitch_name == "Sinker" & abs(SSW_Deviation) < 5 ~ "AVERAGE: Movement is purely from spin. Could improve.",
      
      # Case 2: The Inefficient Fastball (Bad SSW / Cut)
      # (Assuming RHP for simplicity; logic flips for LHP)
      pitch_name == "4-Seam Fastball" & abs(SSW_Deviation) > 15 ~ "WARNING: Accidental Cut/Inefficiency detected.",
      pitch_name == "4-Seam Fastball" & abs(SSW_Deviation) < 5 ~ "ELITE: Pure Backspin efficiency.",
      
      # Case 3: The 'Disappearing' Changeup
      pitch_name == "Changeup" & SSW_Deviation > 20 ~ "UNICORN: Massive non-Magnus fade.",
      
      TRUE ~ "Standard Movement"
    )
  )

# --- REPORT CARD GENERATOR ---
# Let's look at a specific player's repertoire to see the insights
player_report <- analyzed_data %>%
  filter(player_name == "Holmes, Clay") %>% # Change to any pitcher
  group_by(pitch_name) %>%
  summarise(
    Pitches = n(),
    Avg_Spin_Axis = round(mean(spin_axis, na.rm=TRUE), 0),
    Avg_Observed_Axis = round(mean(Observed_Axis, na.rm=TRUE), 0),
    Avg_Deviation = round(mean(SSW_Deviation, na.rm=TRUE), 1),
    # Get the most common Insight for this pitch
    Dominant_Insight = names(which.max(table(Insight)))
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(Pitches))

print(player_report)
```

```{r}
# =======================================================
#   STEP 1: IDENTIFY THE "ALREADY HAS SINKER" LIST
# =======================================================
already_throws_sinker <- ssw_data %>%
  filter(pitch_name == "Sinker") %>%
  pull(player_name) %>%
  unique()

# =======================================================
#   STEP 2: TRAIN MODEL (On Sinker Data)
# =======================================================
# We want to learn: "What does an Elite Sinker release look like?"
# Constraint: We CANNOT use Velocity or Spin Rate as features, 
# because we will be testing this on Changeups (which are slower).
# We rely on Geometry (Release Point) and Spin Axis.

train_data <- ssw_data %>%
  filter(pitch_name == "Sinker") %>%
  filter(!is.na(release_pos_x), !is.na(release_pos_z), !is.na(release_extension), !is.na(spin_axis)) %>%
  mutate(
    # Target: Elite Sinker (>15 deg deviation)
    Is_Elite_Sinker = ifelse(abs(SSW_Deviation) > 15, 1, 0),
    Is_LHP = ifelse(p_throws == "L", 1, 0)
  )

# Features: Geometry Only
train_matrix <- as.matrix(train_data %>% select(
  release_pos_z,      # Height
  release_pos_x,      # Side
  release_extension,  # Extension
  spin_axis,          # Axis (Crucial: CH and SI often share axis)
  Is_LHP
))

train_labels <- train_data$Is_Elite_Sinker

# Train the "Sinker Geometry" Model
geom_model <- xgboost(
  data = train_matrix, 
  label = train_labels,
  max.depth = 4,
  eta = 0.1,
  nrounds = 50,
  objective = "binary:logistic",
  verbose = 0
)

# =======================================================
#   STEP 3: TEST ON CHANGEUP THROWERS (Who don't Sinker)
# =======================================================

# 1. Filter for Changeups
# 2. Exclude pitchers who already throw a sinker
ch_candidates <- ssw_data %>%
  filter(pitch_name == "Changeup") %>%
  filter(!player_name %in% already_throws_sinker) %>%
  filter(!is.na(release_pos_x), !is.na(release_pos_z), !is.na(release_extension), !is.na(spin_axis)) %>%
  mutate(Is_LHP = ifelse(p_throws == "L", 1, 0))

# 3. Predict: "Does this Changeup's release geometry look like an Elite Sinker?"
candidate_matrix <- as.matrix(ch_candidates %>% select(
  release_pos_z, 
  release_pos_x, 
  release_extension, 
  spin_axis,
  Is_LHP
))

ch_candidates$Sinker_Shape_Score = predict(geom_model, candidate_matrix)

# =======================================================
#   STEP 4: RANK THE "GOLDEN" CANDIDATES
# =======================================================

golden_candidates <- ch_candidates %>%
  group_by(player_name) %>%
  summarise(
    # Renaming variables here
    `2025_CH_thrown` = n(),                   # Was "Pitches"
    Avg_CH_Deviation = mean(abs(SSW_Deviation)),
    Sinker_Fit_Score = mean(Sinker_Shape_Score) * 100,
    Avg_CH_Velo = mean(release_speed)         # Was "Avg_Velo"
  ) %>%
  filter(`2025_CH_thrown` > 50) %>%
  
  # THE GOLDEN FILTER:
  filter(Avg_CH_Deviation > 15, Sinker_Fit_Score > 60) %>%
  
  # REORDER COLUMNS
  # 1. Name -> 2. Fit Score -> [Middle Cols] -> Last: Count
  select(player_name, Sinker_Fit_Score, Avg_CH_Deviation, Avg_CH_Velo, `2025_CH_thrown`) %>%
  
  arrange(desc(Avg_CH_Deviation)) 

# =======================================================
#   STEP 5: VIEW RESULTS
# =======================================================

print("--- THE 'SECRET SINKER' CANDIDATES ---")
print("These pitchers don't throw a Sinker, but their Changeup proves they have the SSW skill:")
print(head(golden_candidates, 15))
```

```{r}
# =======================================================
#   JHOAN DURAN: 4-SEAM FASTBALL (Swapped Axes)
# =======================================================

duran_data <- ssw_data %>%
  filter(player_name == "Duran, Jhoan") %>%
  filter(pitch_name == "4-Seam Fastball")

duran_stats <- duran_data %>%
  summarise(
    Avg_Velo = round(mean(release_speed, na.rm = TRUE), 1),
    Avg_Deviation = round(mean(SSW_Deviation, na.rm = TRUE), 1)
  )

ggplot(duran_data, aes(x = Inferred_Axis, y = Observed_Axis)) +  # SWAPPED
  
  geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, color = "#555555", linetype = "longdash", linewidth = 0.8, alpha = 0.5) +
  
  geom_point(
    shape = 21,
    fill = "#004687",
    color = "white",
    stroke = 0.5,
    size = 4, 
    alpha = 0.75
  ) +
  
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(0, 360), breaks = seq(0, 360, 90)) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 360), breaks = seq(0, 360, 90)) +
  coord_fixed() +
  
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 18, margin = margin(b = 5)),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 12, color = "grey30", margin = margin(b = 15)),
    plot.caption = element_text(size = 10, color = "grey40", hjust = 0, margin = margin(t = 10)),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major = element_line(color = "#E5E5E5"),
    axis.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 11),
    axis.text = element_text(color = "grey20")
  ) +
  
  labs(
    title = "Jhoan Duran: 4-Seam Fastball",
    subtitle = paste0("Avg SSW Deviation: ", duran_stats$Avg_Deviation, "°"),
    x = "Inferred Axis",   # X-AXIS
    y = "Observed Axis",    # Y-AXIS
    caption = "Dots on the line = No SSW (Pure Magnus)"
  )
```

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)

# =======================================================
#   CLAY HOLMES: SINKER & CHANGEUP (Swapped Axes)

holmes_combo <- ssw_data %>%
  filter(player_name == "Holmes, Clay") %>%
  filter(pitch_name %in% c("Sinker", "Changeup")) %>%
  filter(!is.na(Observed_Axis), !is.na(Inferred_Axis))

holmes_stats_combo <- holmes_combo %>%
  group_by(pitch_name) %>%
  summarise(
    Avg_Dev = round(mean(abs(SSW_Deviation), na.rm = TRUE), 1)

h_si_dev <- holmes_stats_combo$Avg_Dev[holmes_stats_combo$pitch_name == "Sinker"]
```

```{r}
# =======================================================
#   STEP 1: IDENTIFY THE "ALREADY HAS SINKER" LIST (2024)
# =======================================================
already_throws_sinker_24 <- ssw_data_24 %>%
  filter(pitch_name == "Sinker") %>%
  pull(player_name) %>%
  unique()

# =======================================================
#   STEP 2: TRAIN MODEL (On 2024 Sinker Data)
# =======================================================
# Goal: Learn "Elite Sinker Geometry" from 2024 pitchers

train_data_24 <- ssw_data_24 %>%
  filter(pitch_name == "Sinker") %>%
  filter(!is.na(release_pos_x), !is.na(release_pos_z), !is.na(release_extension), !is.na(spin_axis)) %>%
  mutate(
    # Target: Elite Sinker (>15 deg deviation)
    Is_Elite_Sinker = ifelse(abs(SSW_Deviation) > 15, 1, 0),
    Is_LHP = ifelse(p_throws == "L", 1, 0)
  )

# Features: Geometry Only
train_matrix_24 <- as.matrix(train_data_24 %>% select(
  release_pos_z,      # Height
  release_pos_x,      # Side
  release_extension,  # Extension
  spin_axis,          # Axis
  Is_LHP
))

train_labels_24 <- train_data_24$Is_Elite_Sinker

# Train the "Sinker Geometry" Model
geom_model_24 <- xgboost(
  data = train_matrix_24, 
  label = train_labels_24,
  max.depth = 4,
  eta = 0.1,
  nrounds = 50,
  objective = "binary:logistic",
  verbose = 0
)

# =======================================================
#   STEP 3: TEST ON CHANGEUP THROWERS (Who don't Sinker)
# =======================================================

# 1. Filter for Changeups in 2024
# 2. Exclude pitchers who already threw a sinker in 2024
ch_candidates_24 <- ssw_data_24 %>%
  filter(pitch_name == "Changeup") %>%
  filter(!player_name %in% already_throws_sinker_24) %>%
  filter(!is.na(release_pos_x), !is.na(release_pos_z), !is.na(release_extension), !is.na(spin_axis)) %>%
  mutate(Is_LHP = ifelse(p_throws == "L", 1, 0))

# 3. Predict: "Does this Changeup's release geometry look like an Elite Sinker?"
candidate_matrix_24 <- as.matrix(ch_candidates_24 %>% select(
  release_pos_z, 
  release_pos_x, 
  release_extension, 
  spin_axis,
  Is_LHP
))

ch_candidates_24$Sinker_Shape_Score = predict(geom_model_24, candidate_matrix_24)

# =======================================================
#   STEP 4: RANK THE "GOLDEN" CANDIDATES
# =======================================================

golden_candidates_24 <- ch_candidates_24 %>%
  group_by(player_name) %>%
  summarise(
    # Renaming variables here
    `2024_CH_thrown` = n(),                   # Was "Pitches"
    Avg_CH_Deviation = mean(abs(SSW_Deviation)),
    Sinker_Fit_Score = mean(Sinker_Shape_Score) * 100,
    Avg_CH_Velo = mean(release_speed)         # Was "Avg_Velo"
  ) %>%
  filter(`2024_CH_thrown` > 50) %>%
  
  # THE GOLDEN FILTER:
  filter(Avg_CH_Deviation > 15, Sinker_Fit_Score > 60) %>%
  
  # REORDER COLUMNS
  # 1. Name -> 2. Fit Score -> [Middle Cols] -> Last: Count
  select(player_name, Sinker_Fit_Score, Avg_CH_Deviation, Avg_CH_Velo, `2024_CH_thrown`) %>%
  
  arrange(desc(Avg_CH_Deviation)) 
```
